name: Draconic for Dummies
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I knew that book would come in handy some day! Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe.

Don't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers!

Look for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! You'll know the spot when you see it!
narrative.objectives: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.
narrative.offerRewardText: The book is gone! On top of the dirt mound is a note.

chain.subtitle: 12 quests at level 60, 66,750 XP in all.

quests.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Draconic for Dummies
quests.objectiveText: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

quests.name: rAnS0m
quests.objectiveText: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Love Song for Narain
quests.objectiveText: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Decoy!
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.

quests.name: The Only Prescription
quests.objectiveText: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothf

quests.name: The Good News and The Bad News
quests.objectiveText: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.

quests.name: The Wrath of Neptulon
quests.objectiveText: Use the Arcanite Buoy at the Swirling Maelstrom at the Bay of Storms in Azshara.
